concepts.title: A · 杏橙奶油｜温暖、与图标最统一
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity production-quality Chinese iPhone app screenshot for the existing gentle weight-loss coaching app 称小二. This is a redesigned TODAY screen, primarily exploring a new coherent COLOR SYSTEM, with refined spacing and type hierarchy. Not a marketing illustration.
Input image 1: INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE AND CONTENT reference, the existing Today screen. Preserve its actual functions, data and section order. Do NOT copy its green color scheme or its floating blue gear (the gear is Expo developer chrome, not part of the app).
Input image 2: BRAND ICON reference, the already-approved warm apricot scale mascot. Keep this exact recognizable apricot/ivory/cocoa/coral icon in the small top-left app logo; do not recolor or replace it to match the new palette.
Output: one single full-bleed flat screen, PORTRAIT aspect approximately 1024x2176. No phone hardware frame, no perspective, no desktop backdrop, no multiple screens or collage, no palette swatches, no written design annotations. Entire screen including bottom tabs fits inside the image. Crisp legible simplified-Chinese native system typography, correct text, 44-point comfortable touch targets, plausible iOS safe areas and tiny native status indicators at the top. Clean polished implementable React Native UI.
Keep THESE sections in order and these exact texts:
1. Compact header: small approved scale icon + name "称小二", a discreet non-green "已同步" status at right.
2. Greeting "晚上好，测试用户 3". Supportive two-line headline "不用完美，" / "今天往前一点就好。" Use a calm compact editorial headline around 25-28pt, NOT an enormous poster headline; warm but not childish.
3. Two rounded metric cards in one row. Left: "最近体重", main value "79.0", small unit "kg", footer "目标 73 kg". Right: "最近体脂", main value "—", small unit "%", footer "还没设置目标". Weight is the visual priority. Never fabricate a body-fat number. Do not add a fake chart, trend line, progress bar, weight-loss total, calorie number or streak.
4. Section heading "今天记一点". Four compact action cards in a 2x2 grid, each with a refined consistent outline icon: "记体重" / "看长期趋势"; "记饮食" / "文字或拍照"; "记运动" / "做了什么都算"; "聊一聊" / "问教练任何事". Clear hierarchy between label and helper text.
5. Section heading "记录历史". A quiet well-proportioned white or light surface containing two COLLAPSED rows: "饮食记录" with "展开" and a chevron at right, and "运动记录" with "展开" and a chevron at right. No invented meal entries, photographs or additional feature sections.
6. Fixed native bottom tab bar with four evenly spaced outline icons and exact labels "今天", "教练", "趋势", "我的"; 今天 is selected. Bottom home-indicator safe area. No overlap with content.
Style constraints: sophisticated approachable consumer health app, restrained and readable, comfortable breathing room, not a dense admin dashboard, not a gym competition app. Flat surfaces with at most ultra-subtle shadows, modest rounded corners; avoid cartoon decorative art, glassmorphism, shiny gradients, 3D, excessive pill containers and heavy black boxes. All small labels must have strong accessible contrast. Do not use green or mint anywhere in the interface. Preserve brand name exactly as "称小二" (first character 称, NOT 秤). No watermark.
VISUAL DIRECTION A: Warm apricot and cream, coherent with the approved icon. Background very light warm ivory #FCF8F3, card surfaces #FFFFFF, primary accent muted burnt orange #B45836, headline deep cocoa #46362F, supporting text warm gray #796B63. Left weight card pale apricot #F9D8BF, right body-fat card light neutral oat #F1ECE5 (NOT pink). Quick-action icon tiles very pale peach with terracotta strokes; selected Today tab terracotta with a pale apricot rounded highlight. Restrained hairline warm-gray separators. Discreet status badge pale peach and cocoa, never green. Delight through careful typography, proportions and tactile rounded cards, not illustration. All content fits a real usable first screen without exaggerated blank gaps.
